DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与用の口座についてですね。こちらの銀行で、以前に口座をお持ちになったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about an account for your salary. Have you previously held an account with this bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学生のころに作りました。しばらく使っていないので、なくなったと思って、新しく作るつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 利用しない期間だけで消えたと思っていたと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened one as a student. I have not used it for a while, so I thought it had disappeared and intended to open a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the account had disappeared simply because you had not used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使っていないことだけで、口座がなくなったとは判断できません。以前の通帳や口座の情報がわかるものは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Non-use alone does not tell us that an account no longer exists. Do you still have the old passbook or anything showing the account details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通帳は家にあります。まず古い口座がどんな状態かを確認し、新しく申し込む必要があるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新規より既存状態の確認から相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The passbook is at home. I would like to check the old account's status first and ask whether I need to apply for a new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Start by asking to check the existing account rather than applying for a new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が確認方法をご案内します。会社から、給与の受取口座について指定されている内容はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will explain how to check. Has your employer specified any requirements for an account to receive salary?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社の書類には銀行と支店と番号を書く欄がありますが、ほかに条件があるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 給与受取りの指定情報を職場へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The company form has fields for the bank, branch and number, but I have not asked whether there are other conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask your employer about its salary-account requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その条件も会社へ確かめてください。古い口座の情報があっても、現状の確認前に給与の受取先として提出しないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check those conditions with the company too. Even if you have the old details, do not submit them as your salary account before checking its current status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通帳を見つけたら、その番号をすぐ会社へ書くのではなく、使える状態か銀行で聞きます。新規申込みの資料も教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座状態と新規資料を分けて銀行へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I find the passbook, I will not immediately give that number to the company; I will ask the bank whether it can be used. I would also like to know the documents for a new application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the bank separately about account status and new-application documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 既存口座の確認と新規の条件は、担当者と分けて相談してください。いずれも当日の利用や開設をここで約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Discuss the existing-account check and new-account conditions separately with the staff. We cannot promise same-day use or opening here in either case.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社の条件を聞き、家の通帳を持って確認に来ます。古い口座の状態と新規の必要性がわかってから、給与用の情報を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 既存確認と新規必要性が不明なまま登録しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the company's conditions and bring the passbook from home to check. I will provide salary-account details after knowing the old account's status and whether a new one is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not register while the existing account's status and need for a new one remain unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 以前の口座があることを先に伝えていただけましたね。担当の説明を確かめ、次回の資料を控えてからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have told us about the previous account first. Please check the staff's explanation and note what to bring next time before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 果物の札で確認されたい点がありますか。袋に書かれた価格と違って見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something you want to check on the fruit sign? Did it seem different from the price on the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚の札が安そうなので一袋取ったのですが、袋には別の数字があります。棚の値段で一袋買えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚札を一袋の価格と思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelf sign looked cheap, so I took a bag, but it has another number. I thought I could buy one bag at the shelf price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the shelf sign gave the price of one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この棚の札には百グラム当たりとあります。一袋の合計ではないので、袋の重さと価格の表示も見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This shelf sign says per one hundred grams. It is not the total for a bag, so let us also look at the bag's weight and price labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋の重さが違えば値段も違うのですね。百グラムの表示を袋全体の金額として読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 百グラム表示で一袋の金額を判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the price changes if the bag's weight differs. I had read the per-hundred-gram amount as the price of the whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not judge a bag's price from a per-hundred-gram label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望の量で比べると選びやすいですよ。何人くらいで食べるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Comparing the quantity you want makes choosing easier. How many people will eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人です。大きい袋を安いと思って選びましたが、食べ切れる少ない量の物を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安そうな大袋より食べ切れる量を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just me. I chose a large bag because I thought it was cheap, but I want to find a smaller amount I can finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose an amount you can finish rather than a large bag that looks cheap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少量の袋もありますので、袋ごとの表示を見てください。札の割引についても、対象になる品を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have small bags too, so look at each bag's label. Let us also check which products qualify for the discount on the sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 隣の袋も同じ割引だとは決めません。この小さい袋に適用される条件と、会計での価格を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隣接商品も同じ割引と思い込まない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume the next bag has the same discount. I want to know the conditions applying to this small bag and its checkout price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume neighbouring products have the same discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象を照合してご案内します。支払い前に不明な金額があれば、品物を示してレジでもお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the eligible products and explain. If any amount is unclear before payment, show the item and ask at the checkout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋の重さと総額を確かめます。百グラムの価格と一袋の価格を分けて読み、必要な量だけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位価格を袋価格と分けて購入候補を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the small bag's weight and total. I will read the per-hundred-gram and per-bag prices separately and choose only the quantity I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish unit price from bag price when choosing what to buy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示の単位と食べる量を一緒に考えられましたね。ご希望の品を確かめて、お買い物をお楽しみくださいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have considered both the labelled unit and how much you will eat. Please check the item you want and enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 短めの散歩をご希望ですね。いま選んでいる道は、どちらの線でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like a short walk. Which line is the path you are choosing now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池へ下りる線です。行きが下りなら楽そうなので、少し歩いて同じ道で戻るつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行きが楽そうだと選んだ理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The line down to the pond. Going downhill looks easy, so I plan to walk a little and return the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose it because the outward trip looked easy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場合、帰りは上りになります。行くときの歩きやすさだけでなく、戻るときの坂も図で見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In that case, returning will be uphill. Check the return slope on the map too, not just how easy the outward walk looks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 戻る道も楽だと思い込んでいました。上りで疲れないよう、近くの平らな道も比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復の負担を行きだけで判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had assumed returning would be easy too. I want to compare nearby level paths so I do not get tired climbing back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not judge the round-trip effort solely by the outward trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図では入口と同じ高さの休憩所へ向かう道があります。ただし、実際の路面は現地で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map has a path to a rest area at the same height as the entrance. However, please check the actual surface on site.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その休憩所までにします。地図で高さが同じでも、歩きやすさが全部わかるわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ高さでも実際の歩行を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go only as far as that rest area. Even if the map shows the same height, that does not tell us everything about how easy walking is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check actual walking conditions even at the same height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、歩いてみて無理があれば引き返すこともできます。どのくらいの時間を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, if walking proves too difficult, you can turn back. How long do you plan to spend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 長くても三十分です。休んでいる時間も含めたいので、行きにかかった時間を見て、戻る余裕を残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行きの所要を見て往復時間を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thirty minutes at most. I want to include resting time, so I will check the outward journey time and leave enough time to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the outward journey time to adjust the total round-trip time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時間も考えた案ですね。休憩所へ着いたら先へ進まず、その時点の疲れ具合と時計を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your plan accounts for returning too. Once at the rest area, do not go further; check your tiredness and the time then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 池への下りは今日は選びません。休憩所で疲れと時間を見て、来た道を戻る短い散歩にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰りの負担を抑える短い散歩へ変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not choose the downhill path to the pond today. I will check my tiredness and the time at the rest area and make it a short walk returning the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Change to a short walk that reduces the effort of returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 帰りの負担まで考えて選べましたね。道の様子を確かめながら、休憩と散歩を気持ちよくお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have chosen with the return effort in mind too. Check the path conditions as you go and enjoy a pleasant rest and walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帰りの乗換えについてですね。いま地図に保存しているのは、どの停留所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your return transfer. Which stop have you saved on your map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行きに降りた停留所です。帰りもそこから乗ればよいと思って、ほかの場所は調べていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往路で降りた停留所だけ保存し帰りも同じと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The stop where I got off on the outward trip. I assumed I could board there on the way back too and have not checked other locations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you saved only the outward arrival stop and assumed the return stop was the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 進む方向が違うと乗り場が異なる場合があります。帰りに向かう先をメモで示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The boarding point may differ for the opposite direction. Can you show your return destination in a note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この方向へ戻ります。降りた場所の名前だけで選ばず、帰りの乗り場を図で確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 戻る方向をメモで示し名前だけでなく乗り場を図で確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am returning in this direction. I want to check the return boarding point on the map rather than choose only by the name of where I got off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the return direction in a note and check the boarding point on the map, not just its name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内で方向ごとの乗り場を見ましょう。乗換えの前には何をされる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the boarding points by direction in the guide. What are you planning before your transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近くで買い物をします。戻る道を覚えてから店へ行きたいので、店から帰りの乗り場までの目印も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店へ行く前に店から帰り乗り場への道と目印を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will shop nearby. I want to learn the way back before going to the shop, so I would also like landmarks from the shop to the return boarding point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Before going to the shop, ask the route and landmarks from it to the return boarding point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 経路にある目印を図で確認しましょう。道路を横断する場所も案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check landmarks along the route on the map. Follow the guidance on where to cross the road too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗り場が向かい側でも、車道をそのまま渡らず横断する場所を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 向かい乗り場でも車道を直接渡らず案内された横断場所を調べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if the boarding point is opposite, I will check where to cross instead of going straight across the roadway.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Even for an opposite boarding point, do not cross the roadway directly; check the indicated crossing place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。帰りの便について、時間の案内も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is a good idea. Do you need timetable information for the return service too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要です。行きに見た時刻を使わず、帰る方向の時刻を確認し、乗り場と一緒にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往路時刻を流用せず帰路の時刻と乗り場を一緒にメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not use the outward timetable; I will check the times in the return direction and note them together with the boarding point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not reuse outward times; note the return times and boarding point together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、帰りの方向からご案内します。お買い物の後も乗り場を確かめて、気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will start with the return direction. After shopping, check the boarding point again and have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談ですね。お持ちの写真は今回の提出案内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice on a certificate. Is the photo you brought the submission instructions for this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年使った証明書です。今回もこれでよいと思っていましたが、提出先が前とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真は去年使用した書類で今回は提出先が異なると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the certificate I used last year. I thought the same would do again, but the recipient is different this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the photo is last year's document and the recipient differs this time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 以前使えたことだけでは今回の指定は分かりません。新しい提出先の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Having used it before does not tell us the current requirements. Do you have instructions from the new recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールがあります。写真の書類名と、メールで求められている名前が少し違うので、一緒に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メールと写真の書類名が少し違うため一緒に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an email. The document name in the photo and the name requested in the email differ slightly, so I would like you to look at them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the email and photo together because the document names differ slightly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの名前を分けて確認しましょう。メールの全文を開けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the two names separately. Can you open the full email?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 開けます。画面の途中までしか見ていなかったので、必要な項目や枚数の記載も探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 途中しか見ていなかったメールを開き記載項目と枚数を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I had only read part of the screen, so I will also look for the required information and number of copies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Open the email you had only partly read and find required details and copy numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定が曖昧なら提出先へ尋ねるとよいですね。何を聞き返しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the requirements are vague, it is best to ask the recipient. What will you ask them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正式な書類名と必要な記載内容、何枚出すかを聞きます。去年の写真だけで発行を頼まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式名と記載内容と枚数を聞き前年写真だけで発行依頼しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The official document name, required contents and number of copies. I will not request issuance based only on last year's photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the official name, required contents and copy number; do not request issuance from last year's photo alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の指定が分かれば、その内容で相談できます。写真はどのように管理しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the current requirements, you can consult us using them. How will you manage the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 去年の参考と分かる名前を付け、新しい依頼の画面とは分けます。返答を受けてから発行の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真を前年参考と名付け今回画面と区別し返答後に発行を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will name it as last year's reference and separate it from the new request screen. I will ask about issuance after receiving a reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Label the photo as last year's reference, distinguish it from the current screen and ask about issuance after the reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回の依頼と返答をそろえてまたどうぞ。大切な資料をお忘れなく、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come back with the current request and reply together. Do not forget your important documents, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診の用紙で分からないところがありますか。空欄のまま見せていただいても結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you do not understand on the medical questionnaire? You may show it with fields left blank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この部位の名前が分かりません。指でここを示して、痛む場所を説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 用紙の名前が分からず指で痛む場所を示してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not know the name of this body part. May I point here to explain where it hurts?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may point to the pain because you do not understand the term on the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、どの場所か教えてください。用紙の言葉も一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, please show me where. Let us check the wording on the form together too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肘の内側のこのあたりです。この欄が指す場所と同じか、言葉の意味を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肘内側を指してその欄の場所と一致するか説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around here on the inside of my elbow. Please explain the word so I know whether it means the same place as this field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point inside the elbow and ask whether it matches the body part meant by that field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 欄の意味を確認してから記入しましょう。痛みについて、ご自身の言葉で説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the meaning before filling it in. Can you describe the pain in your own words?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 腕を曲げたときに気づきます。原因は分からないので、運動のせいと決めて書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲げると痛むことを伝え原因不明で運動原因と書かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I notice it when I bend my arm. I do not know the cause, so I will not decide it is exercise-related and write that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that bending hurts, the cause is unknown and you will not write that exercise caused it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 感じたことと考えた原因を分けて伝えてください。いつから気づいていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Distinguish what you feel from what you think caused it. Since when have you noticed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝起きてからです。昨夜は気づきませんでしたが、その間に始まったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今朝から認識し昨夜未認識だが発症時刻は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since waking this morning. I did not notice it last night, but I do not know whether it began in between.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you noticed it this morning, not last night, but the onset time is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように分かる範囲でお伝えください。ほかに読めない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain within what you know like that. Are there other words you cannot read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここにもあります。分からないまま丸を付けず、場所と痛みの様子を話して確認してから記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 他の不明語も聞き場所と様子を説明して確認後に記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is one here too. I will not circle something without understanding; I will explain the place and pain, check, and then fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about other unclear words, describe the place and symptoms, then fill in after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、用紙の言葉から一緒に見ていきましょう。記入後は案内をお待ちください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start by checking the words on the form together. After filling it in, wait for guidance. Have a safe trip home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 気になるメッセージが届いたのですね。どのような内容でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You received a message that concerns you. What did it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人と同じ名前の相手から、急にお金を送ってほしいと届きました。本人か分からないので返信していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名の相手から急な送金依頼があり本人不明で返信していないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone with the same name as an acquaintance suddenly asked me to send money. I have not replied because I do not know whether it is really them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that someone with the same name suddenly requested money and you have not replied because their identity is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示名だけでは相手の確認はできません。これまでのやり取りとは同じ画面ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: A display name alone cannot verify the sender. Is this the same screen as your previous conversations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい画面で、以前の履歴がありません。届いた文面と時刻は残してあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 過去履歴のない新画面で文面と受信時刻を保存したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a new screen with no previous history. I have kept the message text and time of receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is a new screen without past history and you saved the text and receipt time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存したものを見せてください。知人の普段の連絡先は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show what you saved. Do you know your acquaintance's usual contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かります。新しい文面にある番号へではなく、前から使う連絡先で本人に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新番号でなく以前からの連絡先で知人本人に尋ねたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I want to verify with the person through the contact I have always used, not the number in the new message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask the acquaintance through the old contact, not the new number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その連絡と今回の依頼を分けて確認しましょう。送金や情報の入力はもう行いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check that contact separately from this request. Have you already transferred money or entered information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 何もしていません。相手が教えた画面も開いていないので、そのことを含めて状況を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送金入力をせず指定画面も開いていない事実を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have done nothing. I have not opened the screen they specified either, so I will describe the situation including that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you have neither transferred nor entered information nor opened the specified screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かったことを整理して相談できますね。今後追加で届いた場合はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can organize the known facts for consultation. What will you do if more messages arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 急がされても送金を決めず、続きの文面と時刻を残して相談します。知人の返答も別にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 急がされても送金せず追加文面時刻を残し知人返答は別メモにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even if pressured, I will not decide to send money. I will save further text and times and consult you. I will note the acquaintance's reply separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not send money under pressure; keep additional messages and times and note the acquaintance's reply separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。保存した情報から確認しましょう。不明なことはそのままお話しください。お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the saved information. Tell us honestly what remains unknown. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物の発送ですね。箱の中にはどのような物が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending a gift. What kinds of things are inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手作り品と書こうと思いましたが、小瓶に入れた液体もあります。まとめて説明せず、内容を詳しく伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手作り品という総称だけでなく小瓶の液体も入ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to write handmade items, but there is also liquid in a small bottle. I want to explain the contents in detail instead of grouping them all together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that there is bottled liquid too rather than only the general term handmade items. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 液体の種類が分かる表示や、作ったときの記録はありますか。内容に合わせて確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a label or preparation record showing the type of liquid? We need to check according to the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 材料を書いたメモがあります。瓶に名前しか書いていないので、そのメモも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 瓶表示は名前だけのため材料を記録したメモを見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a note listing the ingredients. The bottle has only a name, so I will show that note too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the ingredient note because the bottle label only gives a name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容を確認できるようにしてください。瓶とほかの贈り物は同じ箱に入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make the contents verifiable. Is the bottle in the same box as the other gifts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ箱です。ふたを閉めただけで包み方は確かめていないため、このまま送れると思わず梱包も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同箱に入れただけで包み方不明なため送れると決めず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I only closed the lid and have not checked how it is wrapped, so I will not assume it can be sent as it is and will ask about packing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: It is merely placed in the same box and wrapping is unchecked, so do not assume it is shippable; ask for advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包と発送方法の条件を担当に確認しましょう。相手には送る日を約束していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us ask the staff about packing and shipping conditions. Have you promised the recipient a sending date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今週送ると伝えましたが、今日必ず出せるとは言っていません。確認に時間がかかれば、そのことを相手にも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 週内予定だが即日保証でなく確認に時間がかかる場合に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I said I would send it this week, but did not promise it would definitely go today. If checking takes time, I will let the recipient know too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the plan is this week, not guaranteed today, and notify them if checking takes time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 条件が分かってから準備できますね。確認できない材料がある場合はどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can prepare after learning the conditions. What will you do if there are ingredients you cannot confirm?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分からない内容を推測で書かず、記録を調べ直します。液体を入れるかも含め、発送できる条件が分かってから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 推測記載せず記録を調べ液体を含めるかも発送条件判明後に判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not guess and write unknown contents; I will recheck the records. I will decide whether to include the liquid too after knowing the shipping conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not write guesses; recheck records and decide whether to include liquid after learning shipping conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、材料のメモから確認しましょう。箱と記録をお忘れなく、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start with the ingredient note. Do not forget the box and records, and take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の料金のお振込みですね。請求書の案内もご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to transfer a course fee. Have you read the invoice instructions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金額と口座だけ見ました。自分の名前で送るつもりですが、下に受付番号についての文がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金額口座だけ見て自分名義で送るつもりだが受付番号の文に気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only looked at the amount and account. I intended to send it under my name, but noticed a sentence about a reference number below.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you looked only at amount and account and intended your own name, but noticed the reference-number sentence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 振込名義への指定を先に確認しましょう。受付番号は手元で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Check the transfer-name instructions first. Do you have the reference number available?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申込みの控えにあります。この文が番号を名前の前に付けるという意味か、講座の受付へ聞いてから進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号は控えにあり名前前へ付ける意味か講座受付に聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is on my application copy. I want to ask the course office whether this means adding the number before my name before proceeding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the number is on your copy and you want to ask the course office whether it goes before your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先の指示を確かめるとよいですね。振込先の口座情報も控えと照合しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is good to check the recipient's instructions. Have you also compared the destination account details with your copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。請求書を見ながら銀行名と支店と口座の種類を一つずつ確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未照合の銀行支店口座種類を請求書で一つずつ確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I will check the bank name, branch and account type one by one using the invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the unverified bank, branch and account type individually against the invoice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な情報がそろったら方法を相談できます。支払う総額についても確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once the necessary information is ready, we can discuss the method. Will you check the total payment too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。講座の料金と振込の費用を混ぜず、利用する方法でそれぞれいくらになるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 講座代と振込費用を混ぜず方法別のそれぞれの額を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I want to keep the course fee separate from transfer charges and check how much each will be with the method I use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish course and transfer fees and check each amount for the method used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 費用は利用する条件を確認してご案内します。今日は実行まで進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain fees after checking the conditions you use. Will you proceed to execute the transfer today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名義の指示が分かるまでは実行しません。受付の返答と申込み控えをそろえ、情報と総額を確認してから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指示判明まで送らず受付返答と控えで情報総額を確かめて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not execute it until the name instructions are clear. I will gather the office's reply and application copy, check the information and total, then consult you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not send until instructions are known; check information and total using the office reply and copy before consulting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。請求書と返答のメモをご用意ください。確認が済みましたらまたどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please prepare the invoice and notes of the reply. Come again once you have checked. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの袋へ入れる予定ですか。今日のお品は入りそうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you use the bag you brought? Do you think today's items will fit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋しかなく、全部は入りません。袋は要らないと答えかけましたが、追加が必要か確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小袋に全部入らず袋不要と答える前に追加要否を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only have a small bag and they will not all fit. I nearly said I did not need a bag, but want to check whether I need another.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the small bag will not hold everything and you want to check if an extra is needed before declining a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品の大きさを見て袋の数を考えましょう。分けて持ちたい物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us consider bag numbers based on the item sizes. Is there anything you want to carry separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 洗剤を食品とは分けたいです。持参袋は食品用にし、洗剤を入れる袋を一つ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参袋は食品に使い洗剤用の別袋一つを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want detergent separate from food. I will use my own bag for the food and ask about one bag for the detergent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use your own bag for food and ask about one separate detergent bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の種類と費用を確認します。お支払いはどの方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check bag types and costs. Which payment method would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このカードを使いたいのですが、買い物用ではなくポイントのカードかもしれません。支払いに使えるか先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 所持カードがポイント用か不明で決済に使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to use this card, but it might be a points card rather than a payment card. I want to ask first whether I can pay with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your card can pay because you are unsure whether it is a points card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カードの種類と対応する支払い方法を確認しましょう。別の手段はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the card type and supported payment methods. Do you have another way to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 現金もあります。カードが使えると思って操作せず、使える方法と袋を含めた合計を聞いて決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金もありカード操作前に使える方法と袋込み総額を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have cash too. I will not operate it assuming the card works; I will ask about accepted methods and the total including bags before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you also have cash and ask the accepted method and bag-inclusive total before using the card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合計を確認してから進めますね。袋に分ける品はこの洗剤でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will proceed after checking the total. Is this detergent the item for the separate bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。食品は持参袋、洗剤は確認した別袋にします。支払い方法が分かったら合計を見て払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食品持参袋と洗剤別袋を伝え方法判明後に総額を見て払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Food goes in my own bag and detergent in the separate bag we checked. Once I know the method, I will look at the total and pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain food in your bag and detergent separately, then pay after knowing the method and checking the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、袋とカードの案内を確かめます。お買い物ありがとうございました。袋を持つ際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check the bag and card guidance. Thank you for shopping with us. Take care when carrying the bags too.
